market: Europe Polyester Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The polyester hot melt adhesives market comprises thermoplastic adhesives based on copolyester resins offering good flexibility, heat resistance and bonding to polar substrates. It measures sales of finished formulations in granule, film and web form factors for lamination and assembly. BY POLYMER TYPE: Amorphous Copolyester, Semi-Crystalline Copolyester, Bio-Based Copolyester. BY FORM: Granules, Films, Powders. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Textiles & Apparel, Automotive Interiors, Filtration, Electronics & Appliances, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Other hot melt chemistries; heat-activated adhesive films and webs marketed as converted products; polyester resins for coatings or packaging. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
